Messages.Author: Tendoncutter
Messages.Body:
I tried searching for an answer, but I couldn't find anything.

With the recent change to the rules, making anarch a sect and subsequently changing how some cards function, I was pondering making an anarch assamite deck, with the black hand ers of group 4-5.

But I'm uncertain if going anarch, through the various mechanisms, causes the vampire to lose the black hand status, seeing as it is a sabbat "title"/keyword?

Was thinking of combining universal contracts through HL: Judgement, with black hand and anarch tech.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Black Hand is not related to a sect (not even Sabbat) so becoming an anarch will not affect the Black Hand trait. Also Black Hand is not a title. (See rulebook).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Tendoncutter wrote:
> But I'm uncertain if going anarch, through the various mechanisms, causes the vampire to lose the black hand status, seeing as it is a sabbat "title"/keyword?
>
Some of the minion card tech granting Black Hand (or Seraph) status has text tying it to the Sabbat clan, but the vampires who are printed as "Black Hand" or "Seraph" do not. The Black Hand expansion didn't add any rules, just some random card text on a few vampires.

Even without the Anarch-as-a-sect change, you could have an Independent Anarch Black Hand Seraph Liaison, if you wanted.

Messages.Author: Tendoncutter
Messages.Body:
Thanks for the quick replies.

I did know it was not a title, hence the quotation marks. I just didn't know what else to call it, besides keyword .

Will see what I can come up with, though the combination already screams toolbox, which often is a recipe for failure.
